# The `long-path` ES-DE fixture

ROM paths longer than MAX_PATH (260 characters), as the reference library holds three (ADR-0008 §1: the walks and the
reads use `\\?\` paths). Every path below `roms/` that matters is longer than 260 characters on its own, whatever the
folder the fixture is materialized in: two folders of 105 and 95 characters, then a name of 71 to 81. They are
generated by the materializer (`files.json`, written through `\\?\` paths): git on Windows could not check them out of a
working tree without `core.longpaths`. The layout of the `standard` fixture; default settings.

Below, `<F>` is `A Very Long Folder Name Made To Exceed The Classic Windows Path Limit Of Two Hundred And Sixty (Part
One)/Another Long Folder Name For The Same Purpose So That The Whole Path Is Well Past It (Part Two)`.

| Path under `roms/` | State | Gamelist | Length below `roms/` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `snes/<F>/Long Road Of An Invented Game With Many Words In Its Title (USA) (Rev 1).sfc` | game | yes ("Long Road") | 283 |
| `snes/<F>/Long Silence Of A Second Invented Game Without Any Metadata (Japan).smc` | game | no | 278 |
| `./<F>/Gone Far Away Into A Folder Nobody Can Reach Anymore (Europe) (Rev 2).sfc` (snes gamelist) | missing file | yes | |
| `psx/<F>/Long Disc Of An Invented Game With Many Words In Its Title (Europe) (Track 1).bin` | disc member | no | 288 |
| `psx/<F>/Long Disc Of An Invented Game With Many Words In Its Title (Europe).cue` | game, disc group head | no | 278 |

The cue sheet is written by the test (`rv::test::writeFileAnyLength`): `FILE "Long Disc Of An Invented Game With Many
Words In Its Title (Europe) (Track 1).bin" BINARY`, so that reading a sheet at such a path is tested too.

| | snes | psx |
|---|---|---|
| Entries | 3 | 2 |
| Games | 2 | 1 |
| Missing files | 1 | 0 |
| Disc members | 0 | 1 |
